name: Contract Renewal Tracking & Automation
description: Automated renewal reminders, AI-generated renewal proposals, and upsell opportunities

filters.renewal_date: BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '120 days'

config.select: id, name, renewal_date, contract_value, account_manager_id, health_score, services

config.system_prompt: You are a B2B SaaS renewal specialist. Generate renewal strategies based on client data.

messages.content:
Generate a renewal strategy for this client:

Client: {{step_2a.client_name}}
Days Until Renewal: {{step_2a.days_until_renewal}}
Current Contract: ${{step_2a.contract_value}}/year
Health Score: {{step_2a.health_score}}/100

Usage Data (last 12 months):
{{step_2b}}

Provide:
1. Renewal risk assessment (Low/Medium/High + reasoning)
2. Recommended renewal value ($)
3. Upsell opportunities (features/services)
4. Talking points for renewal conversation
5. Timeline for next 30-60-90 days

config.title: Renewal: {{step_2a.client_name}} ({{step_2a.days_until_renewal}}d)

config.subject: Renewal Planning: {{step_2a.client_name}} ({{step_2a.renewal_stage}})
config.body_html:
Renewal Update: {{step_2a.client_name}}

Renewal Date: {{loop.item.renewal_date}} ({{step_2a.days_until_renewal}} days)

Current Contract: ${{step_2a.contract_value}}/year

Health Score: {{step_2a.health_score}}/100

AI-Generated Renewal Strategy

{{step_2c.response}}

Recommended Actions

    {{step_2a.recommended_actions}}

View Full Renewal Plan
